text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I pass by an arcade while on
my way
back from shopping...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Noooo! I lost agaaaain!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A dance game! But I didn't manage to
beat the
top score!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grrrr! I can't let it end here! I'm not
gonna stop till
I get it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds perfect! And easy as
cake!
choice_data_list: 簡単な曲でミスを減らしてみるのは？
激ムズに挑戦してスコアを稼ごう！
choice_data_list_en: How about reducing mistakes with an easier song?
Take on the hardest difficulty to rack up points!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo lowers the difficulty and
tries again.
However...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Uuurgh...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
This is too slow for me. It's throwing me
off, and
I'm missing a bunch of the notes!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Grrr, whyyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Twin Turbo is the type whose
true
potential is only released when
faced with a real
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? One-footed?!
choice_data_list: 片足だけでやってみよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's try it on just one leg.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That sounds cool! All right, I'll give it a
try!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Dancing like this is super hard!
I'm getting
all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I cleared it with only one foot!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha! This is so fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Delighted at clearing the song with one
foot,
Twin Turbo seems to forget all
about beating the
top score.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: A super hard song?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain how she can build up a bigger
score
because there are more notes in
difficult songs.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh? So what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it now! Yeah, that'll be a piece
of pie!
choice_data_list: ノーツをとにかく踏みまくればいい！
choice_data_list_en: Just keep stepping on the notes as fast as you can!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm gonna try it on Super Miracle
Hard
Mode!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo blazes with determination as
she tries
the super difficult song, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaah! The notes are coming too fast!
I'm
gonna split in twooo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
But I'm getting all fired up! ENERGY

BOOOOOST!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I can kinda follow the notes
now! I'll get
it this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo isn't able to get the top
score, but she
does hit a new personal
record.
